nodes.title: Prompt Guide
widgets_values:
## Anchoring The Subject

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman whose body shape and proportions come from <Picture 1>, whose exact facial features come from <Picture 2>, and whose outfit comes from <Picture 3>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - exact face from <Picture 2>, body from <Picture 1>, and outfit from <Picture 3> are retained with natural skin texture.

## Summary of Video

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a short calm video portrait of <Subject 1> standing in a misty forest. <Picture 1> defines her body, <Picture 2> defines her face, and <Picture 3> defines her clothing. She leans against a tree, looks at the camera, then smiles gently.


## Detailing the Description

detailed_description:
Soft cinematic style, shallow depth of field, natural diffused daylight through mist and trees, cool green forest tones, subtle film grain.

[Shot 1] Medium shot of <Subject 1> leaning against a tree in a slightly misty forest. She looks calmly toward the camera. Soft mist drifts between the trees. Camera is static with a very slow push-in.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, cut to a close-up of her face. She gives a soft, natural smile while looking into the lens. Gentle side lighting from the canopy.


## Audio Prompting

overall_soundscape:
Quiet forest ambience — distant birds, light breeze through leaves, soft mist atmosphere. No dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A (or describe what music you want, eg: fantasy flutes and lute playing a beautiful melody)

## GUIDE

if stuck refer to the guide here: [Base Guide](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/docs/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_base_en.md)

nodes.title: Positive
widgets_values:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
The last frame must be reached by the final [Shot 4] at the end of the video.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] A cinematic, dark-fantasy 3D CG medium-full shot frames a young woman with short white hair and red eyes wearing an intricate black outfit with cutouts, long gloves, thigh-high boots, and flowing red ribbons, walking steadily forward down the center of a wet stone street in a ruined city under a cloudy sky. Ornate classical buildings, lit gas lamps, and a red banner line the dark, smoky background, while glowing red magical energy floats across the scene. The camera begins low near her legs, then slowly tilts upward to capture her face.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a side close-up of her face and upper body, where her expression turns suddenly sharp and intense. Her gaze shifts forward with rising tension as faint red magical light intensifies around her.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.500, the camera pulls back slightly in a side view to show her right arm raised high, her hand clenched tightly while a bright orange-red flame rapidly condenses and grows around it. Her body leans forward with force as the fire becomes blindingly intense.
[Shot 4] At 00:10.500, she thrusts her arm forward in a powerful push, releasing the blazing fireball toward the camera. The projectile streaks through the air and slams into the ground ahead, triggering a massive fiery explosion that erupts upward with thick smoke, searing light, and shockwave-like flames filling the frame.
overall_soundscape: Low rumbling ambience, wet street footsteps, rising magical energy hum, intense fire crackling, powerful exhale, and a huge explosion at the end.
non_diegetic_music: N/A.
